Ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock before you allow an app to connect or approve an action.
Folders that Claude and Agent mode can read and write. They can\'t reach any other file.
PocketPilot shows a notification while its server runs, and asks you there before an AI app connects or does something sensitive. It never posts ads or anything else.
Battery savers stop background apps, which would cut off your AI apps. Let PocketPilot run without battery restrictions. It uses little power while idle.

This lets AI apps read the screen and tap, type and swipe for you, only when you ask them to. PocketPilot never reads banking, payment, password or authenticator apps. On a sideloaded app, Android may first ask you to allow restricted settings under App info.

Shizuku gives PocketPilot the same access as a computer over USB, without root: faster taps and screenshots, and settings, permission and app controls. Install Shizuku, start it with Wireless debugging, then allow PocketPilot.
Lets AI apps read your notifications and reply or press their buttons. Notifications from banking and authenticator apps are never shared.
Apps on this phone can connect right away. For the Claude app, claude.ai or a computer, turn on Tailscale or your own WireGuard network under Settings.

Add PocketPilot to Claude Code with the copied command, add the remote address as a connector in the Claude app, or set up a model under the AI tab for apps without MCP, such as DeepSeek, Qwen or a local model.
Ask your AI to take a screenshot of this phone and describe it. This step turns green when the screenshot works.
Some saved secrets could not be read, usually because the key store was reset. Enter them again.
This phone has no screen lock, so approvals cannot ask for your fingerprint or face. Set a screen lock to use it.
